item.text: I found the key attribution flaw: the live observer marks a single same-title Studio row as matched. I’ll make title-only observations ambiguous, then harden the public endpoint to require client/task identity and associate it with the reviewed operation before invoking publish. I’ll also add fixture coverage around that endpoint so identity omissions and retries are exercised at the same boundary.
